It launched a light passenger car in May 1960, and in November 1966 the Ujina Plant, dedicated to passenger cars, was completed within the head office plant. In February 1961, it concluded a technical partnership for rotary engines with Germany's NSU and Wankel, and in May 1967 it launched the Cosmo Sport, the first car equipped with a rotary engine.

Global units sold in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were 1,223,000 units, with a breakdown of North America 582,000 units (of which the United States 395,000 units), other markets 262,000 units, Europe 164,000 units, Japan 144,000 units, and China 71,000 units. entries.188455d84f6f1f9f: This is the domestic business. Mazda Motor Corporation makes automobiles and parts at the Head Office Plant in Fuchu-cho, Aki-gun, Hiroshima Prefecture, the Hofu Plant in Hofu, Yamaguchi Prefecture and elsewhere, and sales companies such as Kanto Mazda Co., Ltd. and Tokai Mazda Sales Co., Ltd. sell them to customers. The company sells directly to some large customers. Because automobiles produced in Japan are also shipped to overseas sales companies, in the fiscal year ended March 2026 there were intersegment internal sales of ¥2,457,705 million against sales to external customers of ¥900,173 million.
